proposed_widenings.name: change_size
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait's primary effect is a temporary creature-size change to Large. The current surface has speed and roll riders, but no effect atom for changing creature size.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action

proposed_widenings.name: availableAtCharacterLevel for SpeciesTraitRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is locked until character level 5. Species traits currently have no level-unlock field or equivalent activation guard, so authoring it now would falsely imply availability at level 1.

proposed_widenings.name: voluntary_end on activated-ability duration
proposed_widenings.justification: The transformation can be ended early by the bearer without spending an action. Current Duration shapes model timed expiry and several early-end triggers, but not owner-initiated dismissal for activated species traits.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required).

notes: The existing species_trait + activation family can carry the bonus action, long-rest recharge, timed duration, Strength-check advantage, and +10 speed. I did not author a partial record because omitting the Large-size transformation would misrepresent the unit's core mechanic.
